completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean every possible biblical connection has been exhausted, or independent scholarly approval.

reading_notes: All 191 native source units were read first and in order. The unchanged source gate and complete original records are embedded in the reading log.

All retained targets and necessary context were read this run. All 197 full source/target/relationship/rationale triples were reread, followed by all 24 final amended/companion triples and every full pending case.

197 distinct passage-range pairs support 185 sources; each range counts as one pair. Six source deferrals, nine read-unretained candidates and six unavailable Revelation hints receive zero completed-source and completed-pair credit.
The all-targets-read flag applies to retained targets; Revelation hints explicitly remain unread and the fresh pinned availability proof is embedded in the log.

Native text and numbering control every comparison. The one same-chapter relationship is explicitly labeled literal same-chapter. This is an initial curated pass, not an exhaustive claim. No production repository file was changed.

review_receipts.reading_notes: All 225 complete actual native source units were read in exact order after the preceding Isaiah reading gate and the complete fresh Jeremiah inventory, before target curation. All 203 complete retained source-target-relationship-rationale triples were reread in five nontruncated batches, followed by 22 full amended or companion triples across 21 source references and the final additional 5:4 precision reread. The peer-requested category refinement at 4:16 was then read in its complete final triple; 23 distinct amended or companion triples across 22 source references are recorded. All 26 deferred source/reason cases and five complete read-unretained source-target/reason cases were reread, including the final 4:12 case correction. All 170 context ranges and 1162 distinct actual units were read this run. Pending cases receive zero completion credit; there are no unread hints. Composite Jeremiah 7:27–28 and native gaps remain intact. This is review of supplied native English, not original-language or every-tradition review.

peer_review_receipts.reviewer: Codex (GPT-6), root independent Isaiah peer reviewer

findings.resolution: Native-wording precision corrections were applied and all 23 triples changed since the independent initial reading were reread with both full passages. All 197 final relationships accepted. Six source units remain pending; nine checked proposals were not retained; six Revelation hints remain unread. No source or pair completion credit arises from the peer pass.
